title: WaterColor "Beyond The M.A.P" 432 Pine Needle Way
h1: WaterColor "Beyond The M.A.P" 432 Pine Needle Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 14 wristbands.- Located in the Forest District of WaterColor- Access to community pools, nature trails, and dune lakes- Conveniently located near Publix and restaurants- 4 adult bikes provided- 6-Passenger low speed vehicle- Fireplace- Garage- Outdoor shower- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Discover Beyond the M.A.P.—a restful 30A escape made for reconnection and relaxation. Accommodating 14 guests, with 5 bedrooms and 5.5 bathrooms, this beautiful Main and Carriage House is perfect for groups or large families visiting the Emerald Coast. Guests are only a 7-minute stroll to Camp WaterColor and minutes from the fun of Seagrove Beach and Seaside, plus have access to all of WaterColor’s resort-style pools and the beach club!A wraparound front porch with patio armchairs and a cushioned porch swing paints an idyllic picture upon arrival at the 2-story Main House. Inside, rustic wood floors juxtaposed against white shiplap walls create a welcoming, coastal environment. In the living space, 2 plush couches, stylish recliners, a fireplace, and a TV encourage laid-back movie nights. A pass-through and 4-seat island make it easy to entertain from the kitchen, which features top-of-the-line appliances, including a 6-burner gas range, and plenty of storage. Indulge in a seafood feast at the dining table tucked past the kitchen, or on the side porch’s patio table. The sprawling back deck has ample seating and a grill for spending time outdoors. A convenient outdoor shower, plus a mudroom with a washer and dryer, makes freshening up post-beach trips simple. This level has a guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom.An additional living space on the second floor offers room to spread out and includes 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds. Adjacent is a lovely sunroom perfect for entertaining kids with access to 2 furnished porches. The primary bedroom and 1 guest bedroom each boast a king bed and a private bathroom—the primary bedroom boasts a private, covered porch with soft seating. The other guest bedroom has a comfortable queen bed.On the third level, find an open sleeping loft with 2 twin beds.Relax with a friendly game around the top-floor lookout’s card table, or step onto the balcony for fresh air beside the towering pines.The private Carriage House includes a kitchen, a living space with a full sleeper sofa, and a guest bedroom with a queen bed and a private bathroom.Enjoy the charm of a WaterColor getaway at Beyond the M.A.P. Exploring is easy with on-site parking, 4 provided adult bikes, and a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle. Beach access is available at the WaterColor Beach Club, with a second access point off Goldenrod Circle. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 14):FIRST FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Additional Sleeping Area: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:-Additional Sleeping Area: 2 Twin BedsCARRIAGE HOUSE:-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Living Area: Full Sleeper Sofa*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to fines.

body_text_excerpt: Destinations Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Watch Video WaterColor "Beyond The M.A.P" 432 Pine Needle Way Santa Rosa Beach, Florida Bedrooms 5 Beds 11 Sleeps 14 Full Baths 5 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 14 wristbands. - Located in the Forest District of WaterColor - Access to community pools, nature trails, and dune lakes - Conveniently located near Publix and restaurants - 4 adult bikes provided - 6-Passenger low speed vehicle - Fireplace - Garage - Outdoor shower - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico. DETAILS: Discover Beyond the M.A.P.—a restful 30A escape made for reconnection and relaxation. Accommodating 14 guests, with 5 bedrooms and 5.5 bathrooms, this beautiful Main and Carriage House is perfect for groups or large families visiting the Emerald Coast. Guests are only a 7-minute stroll to Camp WaterColor and minutes from the fun of Seagrove Beach and Seaside, plus have access to all of WaterColor’s resort-style pools and the beach club! A wraparound front porch with patio armchairs and a cushioned porch swing paints an idyllic picture upon arrival at the 2-story Main House. Inside, rustic wood floors juxtaposed against white shiplap walls create a welcoming, coastal environment. In the living space, 2 plush couches, stylish recliners, a fireplace, and a TV encourage laid-back movie nights. A pass-through and 4-seat island make it easy to entertain from the kitchen, which features top-of-the-line appliances, including a 6-burner gas range, and plenty of storage. Indulge in a seafood feast at the dining table tucked past the kitchen, or on the side porch’s patio table. The sprawling back deck has ample seating and a grill for spending time outdoors. A convenient outdoor shower, plus a mudroom with a washer and dryer, makes freshening up post-beach trips simple. This level has a guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom. An additional living space on the second floor offers room to spread out and includes 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds. Adjacent is a lovely sunroom perfect for entertaining kids with access to 2 furnished porches. The primary bedroom and 1 guest bedroom each boast a king bed and a private bathroom—the primary bedroom boasts a private, covered porch with soft seating. The other guest bedroom has a comfortable queen bed. On the third level, find an open sleeping loft with 2 twin beds. Relax with a friendly game around the top-floor lookout’s card table, or step onto the balcony for fresh air beside the towering pines. The private Carriage House includes a kitchen, a living space with a full sleeper sofa, and a guest bedroom with a queen bed and a private bathroom. Enjoy the charm of a WaterColor getaway at Beyond the M.A.P. Exploring is easy with on-site parking, 4 provided adult bikes, and a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle. Beach access is available at the WaterColor Beach Club, with a second access point off Goldenrod Circle. Book today!
